Title: JWT Decoder
Description: Decode and verify JSON Web Tokens (JWT) directly in your browser.
LinkToEncoder: Need to generate a JWT? Try the JWT Encoder
Seo_Introduction: The JWT Decoder is a privacy-first online tool designed for developers. All processing happens locally in your browser using WebAssembly, ensuring your data never leaves your device.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
This tool provides comprehensive functionality for jwt decoder operations. Built with modern web technologies and powered by Rust-compiled WebAssembly, it delivers native-like performance directly in your browser.

The interface is designed for efficiency and ease of use, with support for both text input and file processing. All operations are performed client-side, guaranteeing complete privacy and security for your sensitive data.
Seo_Examples:
**Example 1**: Use the JWT Decoder to inspect token headers and payloads in your development workflow.

**Example 2**: Verify JWT signatures directly without sending tokens to any server, maintaining complete privacy.

**Example 3**: Integrate the tool into your daily development tasks for improved productivity.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Prepare Your Input
Enter your data in the input field or upload a file from your device.

### Step 2: Configure Options
Adjust the tool settings according to your needs.

### Step 3: Process and Copy Results
Click the action button to process your input and copy the results to your clipboard.
Seo_Tips:
- All processing happens in your browser for maximum privacy
- The tool works offline after initial page load
- Your preferences are saved locally in your browser
- Large files are supported with progress tracking
